root.label: Lolldaiga fire court ruling and settlement

events.label: Lolldaiga fire court ruling and settlement

slots.name: settlement amount
slots.sentence: Last year, the UK agreed to pay 2.9 million pounds ($4m) to 7,723 claimants, some receiving as little as 22,500 Kenyan shillings — about $175 — and, under the confidential settlement, the UK accepted no liability for the fire.

slots.name: jurisdiction ruling date
slots.sentence: In March 2022, the Environment and Land Court agreed. Justice Antonina Kossy Bor ruled that in signing the agreement, the UK had “waived their immunity to the extent stipulated”, giving Kenya jurisdiction over the Lolldaiga claim.

slots.name: claimant death toll
slots.sentence: That process dragged on for years, and activists say around 50 elderly claimants died waiting.

slots.name: area burned
slots.sentence: The Lolldaiga settlement — for a fire that burned for two weeks, scorched 12,000 acres, killed one man and left thousands breathing smoke — averaged under 400 pounds ($530) per claimant.
